note: APPLIED 2026-09-06 (13:28 UTC) by the Coordinator via tools/apply-migration.mjs, one txn, apply result [] — hr_claim_quest__ungated md5 a20ff223 (len 4884) + hr_quest_rewards_items_ok landed, §4 passed; live-hash re-measured --live: live == replay 10372c99; Security GO-WITH-CHANGES conditions #1/#2 (+#3/#4) landed in d41f395a before apply. (Was STAGED, NOT APPLIED - REVIEW ONLY; the Coordinator applies after a SECURITY GO (it makes hr_claim_quest a writer of player_inventory, a TRADEABLE surface, for the first time). THE BUG: every quest ITEM reward was phantom. QUEST_DEFS authors reward.item/qty, legacy.js completeQuest paid it with addItem() (G.inventory only) and hr_claim_quest credited GOLD only, so the item never existed server-side. Not a post-arm hypothetical: 'shrimp' is a FISH_SPOTS product so src/data/item-authority.js serverOwnedItem('shrimp') is TRUE, and one away-eaten shrimp puts the id in accrue.js consumedKeysOf, at which point the envelope's figure for it is ABSOLUTE - the server says 0 and the whole client-minted stack is deleted TODAY, with the inventory arm still off. That is why first_cook's 30-shrimp first-night grant was withdrawn under Security F2 (2026-09-06) instead of shipped broken; this file restores it by fixing the PATH, not the ruling. WHAT IT DOES: adds public.hr_quest_rewards (quest_id primary key, items jsonb) - RLS on, NO policy, all client grants revoked including TRUNCATE - seeded with the three item-bearing quests (first_cook 30 shrimp, first_blood 5 turnip_seed, farmhand 5 wheat_seed), and RESTATES hr_claim_quest__ungated so it looks the map up, credits it into player_inventory in the SAME TRANSACTION as the gold, behind the SAME (user_id, slot, kind='quest', key=<quest_id>) once-guard, journals it in the existing kind='quest' ledger row (meta.items / meta.skipped_items) and REPORTS it back as `items` so the client can mirror the receipt instead of minting. An id absent from hr_items is skipped and reported, never minted (the gold_500 'small_bones' class). No bank-cap gate, deliberately - one would let a full bag REFUSE a once-ever reward whose once-guard the server has already consumed (the dead-claim class). CORRECTION (Security review, 2026-09-06): an earlier draft of this note and of the file header justified that by 'hr_claim_goal does not gate on bank_cap either'. That precedent is FALSE and is deleted - the live hr_claim_goal__ungated never touches player_inventory at all, so it credits no item and is no precedent. THE REAL RESIDUAL, stated instead: hr_apply's bank check is an ABSOLUTE POST-HOC COUNT (count(*) > bank_cap over the player's stacks, evaluated AFTER it writes items/equip), so a player at their cap who takes this grant can sit 1-3 new stacks over it and until they free one, EVERY item-touching hr_apply of theirs answers bank_full - not just the quest path. Accepted because it is SELF-ONLY (crosses to no other player's economy or ranking), DEGRADABLE (sell or bank one stack and it clears; nothing is lost meanwhile, accrual merely refuses) and BOUNDED (<=40 items across <=3 stacks, once per character for ever). The clean fix is a make-room-or-defer path in hr_apply, that file's job; 2026-09-06-bank-cap-tracks-rungs.sql already removed the largest population that hit this (paid bank rungs never raised bank_cap). Ceiling on the faucet: 40 items across 3 quests, once per character for ever, no period and no client input to the size. gold_in/xp_in/qty_in/gems_in stay 0 (a fixed once-ever catalogued reward is out of the accrual inflow budget - the b414 and muster/raid-chest rule). ORDER: AFTER 2026-08-20-goal-reward-rpc-credit.sql, 2026-08-11-catalogue.generated.sql and - load-bearingly - AFTER 2026-09-04-goal-gold-retune.sql, whose farmhand goal of 6 this restatement carries; re-applying the retune AFTER this file would DELETE the item credit, and Sec 0 refuses to install over a body with no farmhand/ev:harvest arm. IT TAKES OVER THE LAST-TOUCHER ROLE for hr_claim_quest__ungated in tests/live-hash-drift.baseline.json (tracked floor+pin), so the repo's replay md5 moves the moment this lands in the tree while production's does not move until it is applied: expect that entry to read repo-ahead until apply, then re-measure and update the baseline and this note TOGETHER. The baseline was NOT edited by the authoring agent (Coordinator-only). Sec 4 PROVES on apply: 3 catalogue rows and every id real, the 30-shrimp grant present, RLS on with zero policies and zero client grants, the __ungated inner still client-unreachable and the wrapper still authenticated-only, then EXECUTED - incomplete refused with no item credited and no claim consumed, the completed claim credits 200 gold AND 30 shrimp and REPORTS them, a replay refused with neither half moving, exactly one journal row carrying meta.items, and an item-less quest (gatherer) still claiming cleanly with items {}. Probes run in an HR819-discarded subtransaction and the block asserts nothing leaked. Reversibility: re-apply 2026-09-04-goal-gold-retune.sql (restores the gold-only body), then drop table public.hr_quest_rewards; already-credited items are ordinary player rows and are left alone. ALSO IN THIS REVISION (Security GO-WITH-CHANGES): hr_quest_rewards.items carries a value-shape CHECK (object, every value a bare digit string) via the IMMUTABLE helper public.hr_quest_rewards_items_ok(jsonb) - PostgreSQL refuses a subquery in a CHECK, so the jsonb_each_text walk lives in the function - added idempotently as constraint hr_quest_rewards_items_qty_digits for a re-apply over the older shape-only table, and PROVEN to reject on apply by new Sec 4 VERIFY(a2) (accepts a numeric map and the empty map, refuses '30x', -1, 1.5, null, a nested object, a nested array, and a bare array/string/number). Rationale: a bad seed would 500 the ONCE-EVER claim, whose once-guard is consumed in the same transaction, so the player never gets another. Sec 4 VERIFY(b) now asks has_table_privilege over the full PG17 verb list (SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE/REFERENCES/TRIGGER/MAINTAIN) for anon, authenticated, service_role and hr_engine - filtered through pg_roles so a missing role cannot crash the gate - instead of information_schema.role_table_grants, matching the b350 takeover in hr_assert_grant_hygiene (role_table_grants cannot see MAINTAIN and reports the ACL as written rather than as effective). ONE new function object beyond the original re-baseline; the schema-drift baseline moves with it.
